criteria.evidence: Reviewed all six source images and this attempt's native grade images/JSON. Plan target coverage is 100.0/98.1 percent, length coverage 99.2/97.8. F2 has one missed face along the first south-row partition, while its parallel face survives; the partition is not wholly absent. Four elevations retain all 34 opening extents and five structure lines each. Small face/end omissions remain; this is not a perfect trace.

Plan grade overlays retain the L outline, corridor and room boundaries. Furniture and dimension chains are not promoted as whole walls. Extra traced length is 0.722 m / 0.524 m (0.3 / 0.2 percent); small endpoint protrusions remain.

The plan native opening-kind check reports 31/31 and 30/30 correctly named. Elevation E5 is null: these products do not declare opening kind. The word window/door in an elevation grade render is not a producer declaration, so elevation semantic correctness is not certified.

The native rulers agree with the visible 25000 by 20000 mm plan extents and the 7200 mm two-storey elevation height; plan F1 x segments 2240/2400/720/2400/2540/600/4100/300/8000/1700 and East z 1000/1600/1000/1000/1600/1000 match the drawings. Native dimension-chain checks are clean. This is a visual sample and internal-chain check, not independent exhaustive OCR.

Facade labels identify East/North/South/West, but legacy mirrored declarations are not part of these as-drawn products. The native scorer reports assumed mirror for North/West and identity for East/South. North/West grade overlays also show a horizontal registration offset against source pixels; the reported 100 percent extent scores do not establish declaration-level orientation.

This reading contract records face-line runs, gaps and opening hypotheses. Healing those into correction geometry is downstream; the legacy healed-stroke representation is not required here. Plan door gaps remain visible and their native kind reconciliation is clean.
Both full L-shaped plan extents and all four two-storey elevation regions are present in native products and grade images. No whole floor, wing or room band is absent.
